_comment: Recorded baseline of the user-global instruction file that AGENTS.md defers to for precedence. It is not versioned with this repository, so no CI runner has a copy: this record is what the in-repo half of the contract is checked against, and where no real baseline exists the live-file checks run against one materialized from it, so it must stay complete enough to build. Regenerate it deliberately (see RECORD_COMMAND) after an intended change to the baseline, and re-run the lock - the headings and markers recorded here are the contract, so one that disappears is drift.
